# NATATL Recall: deterministic, fully specified 2-agent CGS.
# Agent 1: IDLE, MOVE_FORWARD; agent 2: IDLE, BLOCK_PATH.
# Joint actions use | for agent positions and , for alternative profiles.
# Each state's 2 x 2 locally available profiles has exactly one successor.

# At left/right, IDLE reaches goal, regardless of the opponent.
# The alternate MOVE_FORWARD action leads to a losing trap.
# The proposition a is FALSE initially and TRUE only at goal.
